# arboretum

> A place where komorebi looks (presets) are kept, versioned, and grouped into playlists. Komorebi is a WebGL2
> rendering of sunlight through leaves (https://komorebi.eljojo.net). This file is how an agent uses
> arboretum's JSON API at https://komorebi.eljojo.net/api.

A preset is a komorebi param set: the same flat JSON object the komorebi editor's "copy JSON" button produces.
Arboretum stores it verbatim, keeps every version, and hands it back to the editor.

## Authentication

- Agents use a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The person mints one at
  https://komorebi.eljojo.net/arboretum/settings, with scope `read` or `write` (write includes read).
- Read the token from the environment variable `ARBORETUM_TOKEN`. Never print, echo, log or commit it.
- A token acts as its person, with limits: anything it creates is **private**, it can add versions to any of
  its person's presets (public, unlisted, private or archived) but change only private playlists, and it can never
  make anything public or unlisted, archive, or manage tokens and passkeys. Publishing is the person's act, in a
  browser.
- Every version records how it arrived; a token's versions say `token:<its label>`.
- The komorebi editor (https://komorebi.eljojo.net) is on the same origin as arboretum and uses the person's browser
  session, so it acts as the person, with no token.

## Rules for every request

- Writes (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) must send `Content-Type: application/json`, or they get 415. A write with
  nothing to say sends `{}`.
- Request bodies are capped at 64 KB.
- Errors are JSON: `{ "error": "<plain sentence>", ...details }`. Anything you may not see is 404.
- Visibility is `public`, `unlisted` (readable with `?k=<share_token>`) or `private` (the owner only).
  Archived presets are visible only to their owner.

## What a preset's params may contain

- Only keys the deployed komorebi engine knows (its DEFAULTS, plus old spellings and the editor's `time_of_day`
  and `latitude`), each with its own type: finite numbers, booleans, strings of at most 64 characters.
- Numbers must stay within the komorebi editor's slider ranges, with a quarter of each range as leeway, and a
  select's value must be one of its choices. An out-of-range look is refused with 422, reason `out_of_range`,
  naming the key and its range: `branch_levels must be 1–4`.
- At most 16 KB of JSON, no duplicate keys.
- Keys left out take komorebi's defaults when the look loads, so a partial object is a valid look.
- An unknown key is refused with 422, naming it: `arboretum runs komorebi <sha>; unknown keys: …`.
  A key newer than the deployed engine can't be stored until komorebi is deployed with it; don't rename or drop keys to get past it.
- Komorebi's own built-in looks are not stored: a look that is an unchanged copy of one (the debug overlays,
  `time_of_day` and `latitude` ignored, keys left out at their defaults) is refused with 422, reason `builtin`,
  naming the look. Change something first.
- Metadata: `name` (1–80 characters, required), `description` (at most 500), `tags` (from `projector`,
  `experimental`).

## Presets

- `GET /api/me`: `{ username, kind }`. Use it to check the token.
- `GET /api/presets?owner=me` (yours, private included; add `&archived=1` for archived ones too) or
  `?owner=<username>` (their public presets). Returns `{ presets: [...] }`, newest first, without params.
- `POST /api/presets`: `{ name, description?, tags?, params, komorebi_commit?, parent? }`. Creates a private
  preset and returns it (201). `komorebi_commit` is the 7–40 hex komorebi commit the look was made on.
  `parent` is what it started from: `look:<built-in look name>` or `preset:<id>@<version>`.
- `GET /api/presets/:id` (`?k=` when unlisted): the head version, with `params` as an object. The owner also
  sees `visibility`, `share_token` and `archived`.
- `POST /api/presets/:id/versions` (owner): any of the create fields; a field left out carries over from the
  head, so a rename is a version. Appends a new version (201), whatever the preset's visibility, which it
  never changes.
- `GET /api/presets/:id/versions`: `{ versions: [{ n, name, via, created_at }] }`.
- `GET /api/presets/:id/versions/:n`: one version, whole.
- `PATCH /api/presets/:id` `{ visibility }`, `POST /api/presets/:id/archive` and
  `POST /api/presets/:id/unarchive`: browser only; a token gets 403.

## Playlists

- `GET /api/playlists?owner=me|<username>`: `{ playlists: [...] }`.
- `POST /api/playlists`: `{ name, description? }`. Creates a private playlist (201).
- `GET /api/playlists/:id` (`?k=` when unlisted): the playlist and its `items`, each
  `{ preset_id, version, owner, name, dwell_s, crossfade_s, style, params }`, as this viewer may see them (`version` is
  the preset's head version, `owner` its owner's username). The owner also gets items
  that are unavailable now, as `{ preset_id, dwell_s, crossfade_s, style, unavailable: true }`, and an
  `unavailable` count.
- `PATCH /api/playlists/:id` `{ name?, description? }` (owner). A token may do this only on a private
  playlist, and can never send `visibility`.
- `PUT /api/playlists/:id/items` `{ revision, items: [{ preset_id, dwell_s?, crossfade_s?, style? }] }` replaces the ordered
  list (owner; a token only on a private playlist). `dwell_s` 1–3600, default 30; `crossfade_s` 0–120,
  default 5; `style` is how that item's look arrives, `"morph"` (default) or `"fade"`; at most 500 items. Each preset must be yours or someone's public one. Send back the unavailable
  items you were given to keep them. Send the owner-only `revision` from the GET whose items you edited. A
  stale revision is 409 and changes nothing; reload and reconcile your edit before submitting again.

## Your data, and tokens

- `GET /api/export`: everything the person owns, every version of every preset included, as one JSON. Each
  version carries `params_text`, its exact stored text, beside the parsed `params`.
- `POST /api/tokens`, `GET /api/tokens` and `DELETE /api/tokens/:id` mint, list and revoke tokens. Browser
  only; a token gets 403.
- `GET /api/remote` is the remote control's WebSocket, between an editor that is showing and the person's phone.
  Browser only, from this site's own pages; a token gets 403. Not for agents.

## Limits

Per person: 1,000 presets, 100 playlists, 200 new versions per rolling 24 hours, 10 live tokens. Over a limit
is 429, naming it.

## Handing a look to the person

- Open a preset in komorebi: `https://komorebi.eljojo.net/#arboretum=<id>` (`@<n>` for one version,
  `&k=<share_token>` when unlisted).
- Play a playlist in komorebi: `https://komorebi.eljojo.net/#arboretum-playlist=<id>`.
- Its page on arboretum: `https://komorebi.eljojo.net/arboretum/p/<id>` and `https://komorebi.eljojo.net/arboretum/l/<id>`.

## Example

```
curl -s https://komorebi.eljojo.net/api/presets \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARBORETUM_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"morning, softer","parent":"look:morning 2","params":{"cloud_thickness":0.5,"exposure":2.2}}'
```
